leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement the Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm to find the majority element in an array
Initialize and manipulate a candidate variable and counter to track potential majority elements
Apply conditional logic to update the candidate and counter while iterating through the array
Configure a final verification step to confirm the candidate appears more than n/2 times
Construct a function that returns the majority element or indicates when none exists
Integrate the algorithm into a complete solution that handles various input arrays
